args.title: Fix token lifetime conversion for values over 60 minutes
args.body:
File: src/api/auth.ts

The configuration for token lifetime is taken from an environment variable TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES, and the code does not properly convert values larger than 60 into minutes. This is causing users to be logged out prematurely despite setting it to 12 hours.
